note: Announced, under-construction, and recently opened projects, checked against primary sources where available. Status and dates change; this list is reviewed when the market data is refreshed.

Collin.where: The household growth has moved north and east, to Celina, Princeton, Melissa, and Anna. The corporate relocations are in Plano and Frisco, where the national banks already are.

signals.title: AT&T global headquarters, Plano
signals.detail: $1.3 billion campus at Legacy; 4,000 jobs retained, 10,000 targeted by 2039.

signals.title: Four of the five fastest-growing U.S. cities
signals.detail: Celina, Princeton, Melissa, and Anna, among cities over 20,000 people, July 2024 to July 2025.

signals.title: Dallas North Tollway extension to FM 428
signals.detail: About six miles through Prosper and Celina.

Collin.watch: The national banks are following the rooftops north: PNC opened in Celina in April 2026 and Chase is opening in Prosper.

Ellis.where: Midlothian has the confirmed household and payroll growth now. Waxahachie's large new community is a longer bet.

signals.title: Medline distribution center, Midlothian
signals.detail: 1.2 million sq ft; fully operational in the second quarter of 2027.

signals.title: DataBank campus for Oracle, Red Oak
signals.detail: Up to eight data-center buildings; the first three are under construction.

signals.title: 3,170-acre Minto community, Waxahachie
signals.detail: Roughly 13,000 homes planned; approved by the city council 3-2 in January 2026.

signals.title: Midlothian ISD growing about 3% a year
signals.detail: More than 11,500 students in August 2025; about 350 more each year.

Ellis.watch: Data centers add tax base but few jobs or households.

Kaufman.where: Forney, along US-80, is where the households are arriving. The county's lower-income tracts are around Terrell, where the Amazon distribution center is going.

signals.title: Texas Health hospital, Forney
signals.detail: $171 million acute-care hospital on US-80; opening planned for fall 2027.

signals.title: Amazon distribution center, Terrell
signals.detail: About 1.2 million sq ft and $98 million; state filing July 2026, completion expected around August 2027.
signals.source: Texas Dept. of Licensing and Regulation

signals.title: Forney ISD past 20,000 students
signals.detail: Enrollment passed 20,000 in June 2026; the district's demographer projects nearly 30,000 by 2035.

signals.title: Flexential data center, Talty
signals.detail: 110 acres, up to 108 megawatts; site work from early 2027, first customers late 2028.

Kaufman.watch: A proposed 2,300-acre development near the city of Kaufman was withdrawn in March 2026 after a state investigation.
